Statute.Title: Critical Cyber Systems Protection Act
Statute.OtherLangTitle: (Protection des cybersystèmes essentiels, Loi sur la)

Minister.Text: Minister of Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness (s. 2)

CIF.Text: CIF, 2026, c. 9, s. 11, enacting ss. 1 to 148 of the Critical Cyber Systems Protection Act, comes into force on a day or days to be fixed by order of the Governor in Council see s. 16 — Not in force
